# pve_nodes (Data Source)

Lists every node in the Proxmox VE cluster as reported by `GET /nodes`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "pve_nodes" "all" {}

output "cluster_node_names" {
  value = [for n in data.pve_nodes.all.nodes : n.node]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `node` (String) Optional filter: return only the node whose name exactly matches this value.
- `status` (String) Optional filter: return only nodes whose `status` equals this value. PVE reports one of `online`, `offline`, or `unknown`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Static identifier for the cluster node index.
- `nodes` (Attributes List) Cluster nodes matching the filters (or all nodes when no filter is set). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--nodes))

<a id="nestedatt--nodes"></a>
### Nested Schema for `nodes`

Read-Only:

- `cpu` (Number) CPU usage fraction (0.0–1.0).
- `id` (String) Cluster-internal node ID (PVE 8.x).
- `ip` (String) Last-known node IP address.
- `level` (String) Node capability level (e.g. `c` for current generation).
- `maxcpu` (Number) Number of CPU cores.
- `maxmem` (Number) Total memory in bytes.
- `mem` (Number) Used memory in bytes.
- `node` (String) Node name.
- `ssl_fingerprint` (String) TLS certificate fingerprint (PVE 8.x).
- `status` (String) Node status: `online`, `offline`, or `unknown`.
- `uptime` (Number) Uptime in seconds.
